summary: Staff the Bizerte Port opening by moving two experienced people from Tunis and Sousse, backfilling their duties, training two local-to-be hires' future supervisors, and recruiting the rest.
risks: Tunis Lac loses its marketing lead during the Q4 peak.
Only two internal candidates have store-opening experience.

actions.title: Move Rania Kacem to Bizerte Port as sales supervisor
actions.details: Relocate for 6 months, then review. Housing allowance applies.
actions.rationale: 8 years of experience and team leadership, workload 72%, open to moving.

actions.title: Lead the Bizerte launch campaign
actions.details: Keep base in Tunis, travel to Bizerte weekly until opening.
actions.rationale: Already owns the campaign and has spare capacity (55%).

actions.title: Cover Sousse sales targets during Rania's move
actions.details: Take over weekly target reporting for Sousse Centre.
actions.rationale: Data skills fit the reporting work; workload stays under 85%.

actions.title: Train Karim Jlassi in team leadership
actions.details: Prepare him to act as Sousse sales supervisor.
actions.rationale: Strong sales skills and 3 years of experience; builds a successor for Rania.

actions.title: Recruit 8 sales associates and 2 cashiers
actions.details: Local hiring in Bizerte, start 2 weeks before opening.
actions.rationale: No internal staff match the volume needed.

actions.title: Consider Walid Chebbi for regional coordinator
actions.details: Review after the POS upgrade and the Bizerte launch are complete.
actions.rationale: Delivered the POS rollout and manages projects well.
